history.prompt: Telephoto compression, 200mm long-lens view of endless rows of generic step-van delivery trucks parked in a massive industrial fleet yard. Stacked overlapping layers of structure receding into atmospheric haze, flat compressed perspective. Overcast light, cool desaturated palette with muted tones. No people in the foreground, no recognizable logos or branding on the trucks.

An extreme close-up macro photograph of a heavy metal diesel fuel pump nozzle. 100mm macro lens, one razor-sharp focal plane. Shallow depth of field, visible surface texture, scratches, and dust on the metal surface. Soft directional daylight. The hero object is positioned off-centre on the thirds, with a blurred, muted background falling away.

clean isometric cutaway illustration of a fragmented modular delivery routing grid with intersecting conveyor belts, scattered distribution hubs, and industrial fuel tanks, technical drawing style, axonometric projection, flat muted palette with a bright amber accent colour highlighting the broken pathways, thin consistent line weight, recognisable hardware, generous empty margin

style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: matte clay 3D render of a small mechanical assembly, a unified modular routing block with interlocking tracks pulling apart and fracturing into separate, disconnected paths, studio render on a neutral seamless backdrop, three or four recognisable engineered parts, matte surfaces with moulding seams and contact shadows, single soft key light, matte muted palette, clean structural metaphor for fragmentation.
negative_prompt: text, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, bare geometry, spheres, cubes, vans, trucks, cardboard boxes, toys
rationale: The story describes route optimization—a tightly packed, efficient mechanism—being pulled apart or fragmented by the rush for same-day delivery. A matte 3D clay render of a mechanical module or routing block splitting apart cleanly represents this structural inefficiency without needing literal vans or packages.
subject: a unified modular logistics routing block fracturing into separate, disconnected paths
alt_text: A modular mechanical routing block pulling apart into separate disconnected tracks.
caption: The rush for same-day delivery is tearing apart tight, optimized delivery routes.
title: Route fragmentation 3D render
